source_uncertainty_definition.definition: Reported calorimetric uncertainty convention is twice standard deviation of mean; original report is principal source. Correlations and high-temperature Cp uncertainty are not specified here.

excluded_entropy_phase.interpretation: Rounded reporting value, not proof of exact entropy; no fabricated positive width and no claim that excluded error vanishes.

interpretation: Axis-aligned source-reference perturbation scenarios with Cp and volume fixed; not joint confidence, posterior, or total high-temperature prediction interval. No model refit.

common_reference_feasibility.classification: Linear feasibility of one shared reaction H/S offset within printed-reference perturbation box against all frozen reading intervals. Any witness is diagnostic only, never adopted as fitted material data.
